name: Maarten Vermeer
bio:
Maarten's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying aerospace engineering at Delft University, he became fascinated by the carbon fiber structures used in Formula 1 cars. He detoured from aircraft to automobiles. After graduating, he started as a junior technician at a small racing outfit before moving to rallycross, drawn by the raw intensity and the constant challenge of repairing heavily damaged vehicles.

At Hansen World RX Team, Maarten is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to quickly assess and repair composite damage under pressure. He believes in preventative maintenance and is always looking for innovative ways to strengthen vulnerable areas of the car. His management skills are a valuable asset when coordinating the composite repair team, ensuring that work is completed efficiently and to the highest standard. Maarten is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of composite technology in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maarten is of average height with a sturdy build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting work.
Speaks in engineering jargon when stressed.
Collects miniature models of rallycross cars.
